I hear how much pain you're in, and I'm sorry you're carrying this weight. Feeling hopeless while struggling with both bipolar II and addiction is incredibly hard, and it makes sense that you feel overwhelmed. You're not a bad person for continuing to drink—addiction is powerful, and it doesn't mean you don't care about yourself or others.

What you're describing deserves real support. Please consider reaching out to a healthcare professional who understands both mood disorders and substance use, as they often go hand in hand and need integrated care. If you're feeling unsafe or like you might hurt yourself, please contact a crisis line right now—call or text 988 in the U.S., or reach out to your local emergency services. You can also talk to someone you trust about what's happening.

The fact that you're expressing this here means part of you wants things to change. That matters, even when hope feels far away. You deserve help, and recovery is possible with the right support.
